payloadManifest.source: git ls-files, the tracked payload of the root commit. Built from the untracked file list before the commit existed and rebuilt from the tracked list after, which is the authoritative set.

visualInspection.why: identity rendered as pixels is invisible to a byte-level scan
visualInspection.removalReason: both rendered the predecessor name and version as pixels

predecessor.role: read-only evidence, not rewritten, deleted, or merged

productionUntouched.note: never deployed or restarted during preparation

isolatedTestService.note: listener belongs to another lane; not killed, not reused

rootCommit.subject: chore: initialize TokenProxy 0.1.0
rootCommit.note: Parentless. No predecessor commit, tag, or object is reachable from this history, and no predecessor remote is configured.

secretPolicy.exemptionScope: per-rule, pinned to exact literals. No path-scoped exemption, so a real credential added to a file that already contains a declared constant is still a finding.
categories: native-client OAuth secrets, non-confidential per RFC 8252 s8.5, already published in the upstream package
Firebase Web API key, a project identifier Google documents as safe to expose
fixed public endpoint token (Microsoft Edge read-aloud)
generated test fixtures and documentation placeholders
secretPolicy.verifiedBothDirections: a generated RSA key placed in the same fixture file is still reported, and a github-pat, AWS access key and sk-ant key are all still reported
